note: Scripture authority is the Open Word Bible (OWB), Amharic, Balanced edition (CC0), read offline from the bundled owb-am text, per the founder decision of 2026-11-18 that every Amharic work quotes OWB (the ENGLISH Rooted keeps the BSB on purpose; its Amharic edition quotes the Amharic Bible, now OWB, as Rooted 2/3/5 do). Every quotation was re-quoted to it verbatim: each day's key-verse blockquote, and the phrases each day then explains one by one (several of them in bold).

A `mined` row is a verbatim OWB span in that block: the whole verse or range, the shortest span carrying the quoted clause, or exact OWB pieces joined with '…'. Inner quotations are ‹ ›. `self_rendered` rows (each with a `why`) are allusions, the lesson's own labels and prayers that echo a verse.

Judgement calls. Day titles stay as written (ቀን 5 «አቤቱ፥ ተናገር», ቀን 7 «መልካም አደረግህ», ቀን 10 «መዝገብህ ባለበት», ቀን 16 «ልባምና የዋህ»), as do the series name «ሥር የሰደደ» and the lesson's running labels («በምድር ላይ መዝገብ», «በሰማይ መዝገብ», ልባም/የዋህ, «በኵራት»). Where a bold word is explained, the bold moves to OWB's word for it: Eph 2:10 'workmanship' «የእጅ ሥራ»; Matt 10:16 «እባብ ብልሆች … ርግብም ጉዳት የማታደርሱ»; Eph 5:16 'redeem the time' «ያገኛችሁትን አጋጣሚ ሁሉ በሚገባ ተጠቀሙበት»; John 14:3 «ተመልሼ እመጣለሁ» (the day's title already); Col 2:6 'walk' «ሕይወታችሁ ሁሉ በእርሱ ይሁን»; Phil 1:6 «ይፈጽመዋል»; Ps 1:2 «ደስታው». Matt 25:25 keeps the lesson's 'talent' (መክሊት) for OWB's 'bag of silver' and is self_rendered. The ten Day blockquotes the inventory missed (Jer 29:11, 1 Tim 4:12, Prov 3:9-10, Mark 2:27, Matt 10:16, Titus 2:7 and others) were re-quoted by hand.
